import { useEffect, useMemo, useSignal } from "@shadow-js/core";
import { For, Show, render } from "@shadow-js/web";

export function Counter() {
  const [count, setCount] = useSignal(0);
  const double = useMemo(() => count() * 2);
  useEffect(() => console.log(count()));
  return (
    <Show when={count() < 10} fallback={<p>Done</p>}>
      <button onClick={() => setCount(count() + 1)}>{double()}</button>
      <For each={[1, 2, 3]}>{(n) => <i>{n}</i>}</For>
    </Show>
  );
}

render(() => <Counter />, document.getElementById("app")!);
